description.value: Fresh St. Market is a BC-based grocery chain with a focus on fresh, local, and specialty foods. The Panorama Surrey location is a full-service supermarket carrying produce, meat, seafood, deli and prepared foods, bakery, and a broad selection of packaged grocery staples. It is situated on Highway 10 in a suburban strip, making it a practical resupply stop for cyclists passing through the South Surrey corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wave (3 spaces, covered) at 26m; rack (2 spaces) at 49m. Total: 5 spaces.
